name: Approval
overview: Scripture teaches that true approval comes from trusting in the LORD rather than seeking the praise of men, as fearing human opinion leads to a snare while reliance on God brings safety (Proverbs 29:25; Psalms 118:6). The pursuit of personal glory is cautioned against, likened to overindulgence in honey, which is not honorable (Proverbs 25:27). Jesus instructs believers to perform righteous acts discreetly, emphasizing that heavenly reward—not human recognition—is the ultimate approval (Matthew 6:1). Above all, seeking God's kingdom and righteousness is paramount, promising that all necessary things will be provided (Matthew 6:33), and even when efforts seem in vain, God’s judgment and reward remain certain (Isaiah 49:4).
